items.html: Afterward the fourth king reigned, which is Tifferet. When the light reached its upper third, up to the Chazeh, it drew the phase of the general Hassadim into the Yesod of Aba and the general Gevurot into the Yesod of Ima, as is known. This is why Yesod is called “all,” since it includes the general Hassadim and general Gevurot. We have already explained this image: that Da'at includes the Rosh of Aba and Ima, Hesed is the body of Aba, Gevura is the body of Ima, and the upper third of Tifferet is the Yesod of Aba and Ima. When the light reached the two lower thirds of Tifferet, then all the posterior of the upper Aba and Ima finished descending, and it drew Hesed and Gevura to the heads of Yesh"s and Tevuna, for that is where their heads are together. And when it died, three kings descended into the fifth vessel, which is Netzah. Then the Hassadim descended from the head of Yesh"s, and the Gevurot from the head of Tevuna, down into their own bodies, and also from Yeshsut the phase of the looking of their eyes at one another was diminished, in the same manner as explained above regarding the upper Aba and Ima.
